latest_release.name: v15.1.1
latest_release.body:
Nextcloud 35.0.3 is included

<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at main -->

## What's Changed
### 👒 Updated dependencies
* build(deps): bump azure/setup-helm from 5.0.1 to 5.1.0 in /.github/workflows by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/9064
* build(deps): bump peter-evans/create-pull-request from 8.1.2 to 8.1.3 in /.github/workflows by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/9069
* Bump PHP to 8.4.28 and 8.5.13 by @szaimen in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/9085
### 📄 Improved documentation
* docs(community-containers): warn about unauthenticated ports and data exposure by @szaimen in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/9007


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/compare/v15.1.0...v15.1.1
